description: A governor for all Iowans. Entrepreneur, consensus builder, job creator. A problem solver who listens to everyone. Father of six, grandfather of ten, friend of all. Practical solution oriented. Former law enforcement officer. Lifetime champion of individual liberty. And personal responsibility. Smart, educated, humble. Libertarian at heart, pragmatist in action. No fear, much love.
